blockers: internal budget freeze until business case sign-off
notes:
Lead: VP Product (Claire Dubois). Evaluating Hosted API first to speed to market; goal: embed in product for contextual in-app assistant + semantic search.
- Primary ask: EU data residency for EU customers (France + Germany subsets). Wants confirmation of at-rest residency in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.
- Latency SLO target: 150ms median p95 for short-chat prompts (<=256 tokens) in-west-eu; throughput ~40 req/s for peak workspace queries.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market unit economics. Trial POC budget ~€20k/month all-in. Interested in clear guidance on batching/quant profiles to hit cost targets.
- Model preference: open-model first (gptj-style family / Llama-based verified variants), but open to Redwood-verified curated models. Preference for deterministic rerank step for search.
- Routing needs: multi-region routing to keep EU traffic in-region; fallback to another EU zone before falling back to NA. Concern about cross-border failover rules and impact on latency/PRIV.
- Security: SSO via SAML mandatory for admins; audit logs and retention controls required for compliance team review. KMS integration needed for dedicated option.
- Quote from Claire on 11/15 demo: "We need predictable latency in Paris and Frankfurt — if hosted can't guarantee, we'll have to look at Dedicated or hybrid VPC." 
- Internal stakeholders: VP Product (Claire), CTO (Marco Rinaldi), Head of Security (Iwona Zielinska), Procurement (Elena Meyer).
- PoC ask: 2-week hosted PoC focusing on French customers (~50k monthly queries) + side-by-side Dedicated cost/latency estimate. SE proposed controlled canary traffic via a routing policy.
- Risk notes: Procurement flagged 'data residency' clause in Master Services Agreement; legal wants readout on data lifecycle and third-party subprocessors.
- Technical notes from SE call: suggested quantization + response streaming to shave latency; propose 2x small dedicated nodes in eu-central for baseline comparison.
- Next demo scheduled: 2024-12-09 (deep-dive: routing & residency). Pricing follow-up 2024-12-16 with procurement.

use_case_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS embedding an in-product conversational assistant + semantic search over customer docs and event logs. Need low-p95 latency for UI interactions and EU residency for EU customers. Want hosted PoC to validate latency/UX and then compare to Dedicated for guaranteed capacity and regional isolation.
requirements_summary:
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for short prompts; target 150ms in eu regions
- Throughput: baseline 40 req/s peak; burst to 120 req/s during reports
- Residency: EU-only at-rest and in-transit; per-country residency later
- Security: SAML SSO, audit logs, KMS for Dedicated, SOC2 compliance evidence
- Routing: region-based routing with policy fallback within EU before NA
- Economics: target avg token cost reduction via batching/quantization guidance
